name: AICOSO Pickup and Delivery for WooCommerce
author: aicoso

sections.description:
AICOSO Pickup & Delivery is a powerful plugin that enhances your WooCommerce store by providing customers with flexible fulfillment options. Customers can choose between convenient home delivery or local pickup, complete with date and time scheduling.

Key Features

  • Flexible Fulfillment Options: Allow customers to choose between pickup and delivery at checkout
  • Date & Time Scheduling: Customers can select their preferred pickup or delivery date and time
  • Multiple Pickup Locations: Configure multiple pickup points for customer convenience
  • Time Slot Management: Define available time slots for both pickup and delivery
  • Admin Controls: Full control over scheduling rules, blackout dates, and availability
  • Email Notifications: Automated notifications for pickup and delivery confirmations
  • Order Management: Dedicated admin interface for managing pickup and delivery orders
  • Responsive Design: Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

Perfect For

  • Local stores offering pickup services
  • Restaurants with takeout and delivery options
  • Grocery stores with curbside pickup
  • Any WooCommerce store wanting flexible fulfillment options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aicoso-pickup-and-delivery-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Pickup & Delivery to configure the plugin
  4. Set up your pickup locations and delivery zones
  5. Configure time slots and scheduling rules
  6. The pickup/delivery options will automatically appear on your checkout page
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme. It uses standard WooCommerce hooks and filters to ensure compatibility.

Can I set different time slots for different days?

Yes, you can configure different time slots for each day of the week, including setting days as unavailable.

Can I limit the number of orders per time slot?

Yes, the plugin includes an option to set maximum orders per time slot to manage capacity.

Is it possible to charge extra for delivery?

Yes, you can set delivery fees based on zones or order value through the plugin settings.

Can customers change their pickup/delivery time after placing an order?

Customers can request changes through their account page, subject to admin approval and availability.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and includes .pot files for easy translation.
